items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Zutty Singleton) is narrating a story about Charlie Parker and Fate Maribel discussing Zutty. Maude is mentioned only as part of the band name 'Maude Belle's Fate Maribel's band' or as a possessor of the band, with no direct interaction or personal relationship described between Zut

ctx.x: And when Charlie came back from the Derby he said, Maude, I heard the drummingest son of a bitch I ever heard in my life. I said, yeah, because he cursed every other word was a curse word. If it was just general conversation. And he said he's coming to St. Louis with Maude Belle's Fate Maribel's band. He said, and he is the type of drummer I've always looked for and wanted to hear. He said he is a drummer, talk about a drummer, and he said I invited him to come by and I want him to hear my bands too, and all. Oh,…
because he never did call Zutty Zutty, he called him Singleton all the time.
